name: defra-ai-community-plugins
description: Community-contributed GitHub Copilot CLI / Claude Code plugins for Defra — reviewed by the AI dev team but maintained by the contributing teams, not AICE.

plugins.name: dotnet-upgrade
plugins.description: End-to-end .NET upgrade agent for multi-solution batched upgrades. Discovers components, plans, dry-runs, executes TFM + package upgrades, builds/tests, reverts failures to manual-review, and produces per-component commits with a consolidated batch report.
